summary: YPF Sociedad Anonima filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine repurchase of its own Class XXVII Notes (YMCTO) in the open market. Between July 2 and July 8, 2026, the company bought back notes with a par value of US$3,712,450 at an average price of 98.92% of nominal value. The notes mature in October 2026 and will be held in portfolio. This is a standard capital structure management activity, not a special-situation event such as an issuer tender offer under US rules. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are noted. Watch for any future accretive or deleveraging actions.
